businesses.business: Household and personal care consumer products

offering_description.value: Makes and markets branded household, personal care and vitamin products sold mainly through mass retailers, drug and grocery chains, and online stores to individual consumers. Products are largely made by contract or in-house manufacturing and sold under company brands.

primary_products.value: baking soda; laundry additives; dry shampoo; oral care; condoms; pregnancy tests; vitamins; hair removal products

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying household, personal care and health products; B2B: mass merchants, grocery, drug and club retail chains

end_markets.value: household cleaning; personal care; oral care; health and wellness; family planning

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded consumer products sold to retailers and consumers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets branded products, sold to retailers and consumers; OEM / manufacturer: makes some products in-house and uses contract manufacturers, sold to retailers

geography_served.value: global: US and Canada, plus Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: household products, personal care, specialty products and vitamins sold through the same retail channels

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: mass merchants, grocery, drug and club stores; online: e-commerce sites and retailer online stores; direct sales: sales teams selling directly to large national retail accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA oversight of OTC drugs, pregnancy tests and condoms as devices, plus cosmetics, labeling and product safety rules
